选中文字就弹出横条: Show the bar when text is selected
在任意软件里用鼠标拖选一段文字，松开即弹（内部会等选区落地、失败自动重试，快速划: Drag-select text in any app and release: the bar appears. Quick Search waits for the selection to settle and retries automatically, so fast selections work too.
按 Ctrl+C 也弹出横条: Also show the bar on Ctrl+C
键盘选中后复制，同样弹出来: Copy with the keyboard and the bar appears as well
松手后等这么久才弹，调大可避免还在拖选时就冒出来 · 当前 0 ms: How long to wait after releasing before showing the bar. Increase it if the bar appears while you are still dragging · now 0 ms
横条弹出后，这么久没有任何操作（指针没移上来、没点、没按键、面板也没开）就自己收: Hide the bar automatically after this long without interaction (pointer away, no click, no key, panel closed) · 0 = never · now 5 s
鼠标移远就收起: Auto-hide when the pointer moves away
指针离弹出位置超过这么远，说明这条你不需要了 —— 立刻收起 · 0 = 不收起: Hide immediately once the pointer is farther than this from the bar · 0 = never · now 400 px
划选没取到文字就不弹: Do not show the bar when no text was captured
只影响\"划选\"这一条路：拖窗口、拖滚动条、拖画布这类误触取不到词时不弹。Ct: Only affects drag-selection: dragging a window, scrollbar or canvas will not trigger the bar. Ctrl+C is an explicit action and always shows the bar, even if nothing was copied.
切换后立刻生效，并写进本机配置（下次启动仍是这个语言）· 简体中文为默认: Applies immediately and is saved to this machine (still in effect next launch) · Simplified Chinese is the default
登录 Windows 后自动在后台待命: Wait in the background right after you sign in
只有管理员进程才能把 Ctrl+C 送进同样是管理员的软件（任务管理器、部分编辑: Only an elevated process can send Ctrl+C into apps that also run elevated (Task Manager, some editors). Takes effect on the next launch.
开启后启动软件必须先输入密码才能使用 · 与备份密码互不影响（两个密码可以不同，: When enabled, Quick Search asks for this password at startup · completely independent of the backup password (they can differ; changing one never touches the other) · takes effect on the next launch
只在本机加密配置里存 Argon2id 哈希，不存原文 · 两次输入必须一致 ·: Only an Argon2id hash is stored in the encrypted local config, never the password itself · both entries must match · flip the switch above to turn it off
设置窗口与横条共用的明暗皮肤: Light or dark skin shared by this window and the bar
「跟随系统」随 Windows 的日/夜间模式自动切换。横条与设置窗口用同一套明: Follow system switches with the Windows light/dark mode. The bar and this window always share one skin.
横条胶囊、图标按钮、右侧预览一起变 · 当前 9 px: Applies to the bar, icon buttons and the preview · now 9 px
把预览舞台换成深色背景，看横条在深色页面上长什么样: Switch the preview stage to dark to see how the bar looks on dark pages
预览里的图标点了不会真的去搜索，纯粹给你看效果: Clicking icons in the preview does not search anything — it is purely for looks
三选一，页面只显示当前样式的项；液态玻璃需要 WebGL2，不支持时自动退回磨砂: Pick one of three; only the options for the current style are shown. Liquid glass needs WebGL2 and falls back to frosted automatically (see Help ②).

一键切整套参数；动过下面任意滑块就变成自定义: Switch the whole parameter set at once; moving any slider below makes it Custom
横条跟随鼠标位置: Anchor the bar to the pointer
打开后一律贴着鼠标弹；关闭则贴着选中的文字弹: When on, the bar always appears at the pointer; when off, it follows the selected text
横条优先贴在选中文字的哪一侧 · 那一侧放不下时会自动翻到另一侧 · 打开「跟随: Which side of the selected text the bar prefers · it flips automatically when there is no room · ignored when anchoring to the pointer
按图标实际画面统一大小；关掉则按原图显示，有些会显得偏小: Scale every icon by its actual artwork; when off, icons keep their original size and some look smaller
100 % · 横条整体浓淡（图标跟着一起淡），100% = 实色: 100 % · Overall opacity (icons fade with the bar); 100% = solid
45 % · 鼠标没移上去时的淡度；100% = 关掉这套行为: 45 % · Opacity while the pointer is away; 100% turns this behaviour off
关闭后横条不再有浮现动画: Turning this off removes the bar's fade-in animation
给横条、面板、右键菜单加一层柔和投影，让浮层更立体；关闭则完全无影: Add a soft shadow under the bar, panels and context menu for depth; off means no shadow at all
关 · 值越大越糊，0 = 不模糊；磨砂只负责「糊」，不改透明度: Off · higher means blurrier; 0 = no blur. Blur only blurs, it never changes opacity.
30 ‰ · 横条边缘处背景被扭曲的程度。太小看不出\"厚玻璃\"，太大会让边缘: 30 ‰ · How strongly the background bends at the bar's edges. Too low and it does not read as thick glass; too high and edge text smears.
18 ‰ · 模拟玻璃有多厚：越大，边缘处的背景被放大得越厉害: 18 ‰ · Simulated glass thickness: higher magnifies the background near the edges
50 % · 红蓝通道分离，一眼看出「不是塑料」；0 = 关: 50 % · Red/blue channel separation that makes it read as real glass; 0 = off
110 % · 鼠标跟随的镜面光斑 + 上下缘的锐利亮线，玻璃的立体感全靠它: 110 % · Pointer-following specular highlight plus sharp rim lines; this is what makes the glass look solid
14 % · 玻璃本体微微带色（亮色下偏白、暗色下压一层深蓝，自动跟着明暗主题走: 14 % · A subtle tint in the glass itself (whiter in light mode, deep blue in dark mode; follows the theme)
2 px · 玻璃内部的磨砂 —— 糊的是折射进来的桌面，不是横条底板: 2 px · Frost inside the glass — it blurs the refracted desktop, not the bar itself
持续重抓背后桌面（背后放视频也跟得上）；开启后横条对抓屏隐身，关 = 只抓一次: Keep recapturing the desktop behind the bar so video plays through it. When on, the bar is hidden from screen capture. Off = capture once.
横条跟随桌面变化的频率。抓屏一次约 6 ms（与抓取大小无关，是系统抓屏的固有开: How often the bar follows the desktop. One capture costs about 6 ms (fixed system cost, independent of size), so higher rates cost more CPU. Default 30: scrolling and video already look smooth.
在哪些软件里不弹 / 只在哪里弹: Where the bar appears and where it stays away
白名单模式最省心：只在你列出的软件里弹: Whitelist is the simplest: the bar only appears in the apps you list
一行一个进程名，例如 notepad.exe；不区分大小写: One process name per line, e.g. notepad.exe; case-insensitive
